verdict.rationale: Whether an email service publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions Gmail's source code being available or openly licensed. Its documented APIs, add-ons, and IMAP/SMTP support concern programmatic access, not source availability, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
